title: Concept: Unstable releases are accepted whenever a range allows them
description: composer.json declares a composer.json with `prefer-stable` false, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a composer.json with `prefer-stable` false.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through composer.json (composer).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a composer.json with `prefer-stable` false.
